title: Middle Management
overview: After the sudden death of the gang's underboss, brilliant financial strategist Darnell Washington is unexpectedly promoted to lead operations. Determined to modernize the organization through structure, efficiency and discipline, he quickly discovers that intelligence alone cannot stop a war. When a rival boss seeks revenge for a murder committed by Darnell's father years earlier, Darnell must choose between protecting his family and becoming the very monster he swore he'd never become.
